Here’s a 12-week, phase-based program starting Monday 2026-06-01, designed for a 31-year-old female with PCOS (Rotterdam), irregular cycles, HbA1c 5.8, BMI 28. Primary aim: improve insulin sensitivity and body composition via progressive resistance training, while protecting against under-fuelling/overtraining. The plan emphasizes consistent strength work, moderate conditioning, recovery, and fueling structure to stabilize energy availability and support cycle health.

Structure overview
- Frequency: 4 training days/week (3 resistance + 1 conditioning), 1 optional low-intensity NEAT day, 2 full rest days.
- Phases:
  - Phase 1 (Weeks 1-4): Foundation and insulin-sensitizing volume
  - Phase 2 (Weeks 5-8): Progressive overload and strength focus
  - Phase 3 (Weeks 9-12): Strength consolidation + metabolic density
- Session length: 45–65 minutes
- Intensity guidance: RPE 6–8 for main lifts; deloads built in.
- Conditioning: Short, low-to-moderate intensity to avoid stress load spikes.
- Recovery guardrails: Sleep 7.5–9 h, step target 7–9k/day, HRV/resting HR monitoring if available.
- Fueling: Protein-forward, eucaloric or slight deficit only if energy availability remains high; carbohydrate timing around training.

Weekly schedule template
- Mon: Lower Body Strength
- Tue: Upper Body Strength
- Wed: Recovery/NEAT (optional 30–45 min walk + mobility) or Rest
- Thu: Full-Body Strength
- Fri: Rest
- Sat: Conditioning (low-to-moderate intensity, short)
- Sun: Rest + Prep

Key coaching notes for PCOS and insulin sensitivity
- Prioritize compound resistance training 3x/week; steady progression in load/volume improves glucose disposal.
- Keep conditioning modest; avoid long fasted HIIT sessions (can elevate cortisol and worsen symptoms).
- Fuel pre/ post sessions; avoid low-carb on training days.
- Watch for RED-S/under-fuelling signs: disrupted sleep, elevated resting HR, irritability, stalled progress, increased cycle irregularity.
- If a spontaneous bleed occurs, reduce volume 10–20% during heavy symptom days.

Warm-up protocol for all lift days (10–12 min)
- 3–5 min easy cardio (bike/row/walk)
- Dynamic mobility: ankle rocks, 90/90 hips, T-spine openers (4–6 reps each)
- Movement prep: glute bridge 2x8, band pull-aparts 2x12, dead bug 2x6/side
- Specific warm-up sets ramping to working weight (2–3 sets of 5–3 reps)

Phase 1 — Foundation and Insulin Sensitivity (Weeks 1–4)
Goals: Groove technique, increase weekly muscle stimulus, create stable routine, emphasize controlled tempos. RPE ~6–7 early.

Week 1 (2026-06-01 to 06-07)
- Mon (Lower A)
  - Back squat or goblet squat 3x8 @ RPE 6
  - Romanian deadlift 3x8
  - Split squat 3x8/side
  - Leg curl (machine or ball) 3x10
  - Standing calf raise 2x12
  - Core: side plank 2x30–40s/side
- Tue (Upper A)
  - Flat DB press 3x8
  - One-arm DB row 3x10/side
  - Seated DB shoulder press 3x8
  - Lat pulldown (or assisted pull-up) 3x10
  - Incline push-up 2x10–12
  - Pallof press 2x10/side
- Thu (Full Body A)
  - Trap bar deadlift (or kettlebell deadlift) 3x6
  - Front-foot-elevated split squat 3x8/side
  - Push-up (incline as needed) 3x8–10
  - Cable row 3x10
  - Hip thrust 2x10
  - Farmer carry 2x30–40m
- Sat (Conditioning A)
  - 20–25 min brisk incline walk or cycle, Zone 2 (nasal breathing possible)
  - Finish: mobility 8–10 min

Week 2
- Progress load +2.5–5% or 1 rep per set if RPE ≤7.
- Same exercise menu as Week 1; add one set to first lower and first upper compound:
  - Squat 4x8; DB press 4x8
- Conditioning: 25–30 min Zone 2 or 10 x 45s easy spin + 45s easy roll (not HIIT), total 25 min.

Week 3
- Slight intensity bump; aim RPE 7 on final set.
- Mon (Lower B): keep sets; shift RDL to 4x8. Add glute med work: banded lateral walks 2x12/side.
- Tue (Upper B): add face pull 2x12; keep rows/pulls at 4x10.
- Thu (Full Body B): trap bar deadlift 4x5; hip thrust 3x8; farmer carry 3x30–40m.
- Sat: 25–30 min Zone 2 + 4 x 10s relaxed strides or 4 x 15s spin-ups (full recovery).

Week 4 — Deload/Technique
- Reduce volume ~30% and cap RPE at 6.
- Compounds 2–3 sets each; maintain frequency.
- Conditioning 20 min easy.
- Assess readiness, sleep, cycle symptoms, and appetite; prepare to increase loads in Phase 2.

Phase 2 — Progressive Overload and Strength Focus (Weeks 5–8)
Goals: Increase load, nudge reps down for strength, sustain weekly volume. Add one higher-density finisher per week without spiking stress.

Week 5
- Mon (Lower Strength 1)
  - Back squat 4x6 @ RPE 7–8
  - RDL 4x6
  - Walking lunge 3x10/side
  - Seated leg curl 3x8–10
  - Core: cable chop 3x10/side
- Tue (Upper Strength 1)

  - Chest-supported row 4x8
  - Half-kneeling single-arm landmine press 3x8/side
  - Lat pulldown (neutral) 3x8–10
  - Biceps curl 2x10–12; Triceps rope 2x10–12

- Mid-program check: fasting glucose trends (if tracked), resting HR/HRV, menstrual symptoms, energy levels. If signs of under-fuelling, increase carbs by 25–40 g/day and reduce conditioning further.

Phase 3 — Strength Consolidation + Metabolic Density (Weeks 9–12)
Goals: Maintain/intensify strength on key lifts while adding short density blocks to enhance glucose uptake without excessive stress. Finish with conservative test week.

Here is the complete 12-week program starting Monday 2026-06-01, integrating all adjustments: intensified Phase 2, cardio add-ons with cautious HIIT dosing, glycaemic-control nutrition, and safe end-of-block submax testing. It’s written week-by-week with sessions, sets/reps/RPE, cardio, fueling, and recovery guardrails specific to PCOS and the under-fuelling risk.

Global structure
- Weekly template: Mon Lower Strength, Tue Upper Strength, Wed Optional NEAT/recovery, Thu Full-Body Strength, Fri Rest, Sat Cardio/HIIT as programmed, Sun Zone 2 or Rest
- Frequency: 4 training days + 1–2 aerobic sessions (mostly Zone 2)
- Phases: P1 Weeks 1–4 (Foundation), P2 Weeks 5–8 (Intensified Strength), P3 Weeks 9–12 (Consolidation + Submax Testing)
- Intensity anchors: Main lifts RPE 6–8 (up to 8.5 in Phase 2 peak), accessories 2–3 RIR
- Cardio ceiling: Generally 90–140 min/week, mostly Zone 2, with optional 1 HIIT/week in select weeks (never back-to-back or near heavy lower days)
- Warm-up every lift day (10–12 min): 3–5 min easy cardio; dynamic mobility (ankle rocks, 90/90 hips, T-spine openers 4–6 reps); activation (glute bridge 2x8, band pull-aparts 2x12, dead bug 2x6/side); 2–3 ramp-up sets to working weight

Nutrition overview (glycaemic control and weight loss)
- Energy: Start at maintenance Weeks 1–2. Introduce ≤10% deficit 3–5 days/week from Week 3 onward as recovery allows. Avoid aggressive cuts.
- Protein: 1.6–2.0 g/kg/day split across 3–4 meals (25–35 g/meal)
- Carbs: Training days 3.0–4.0 g/kg; rest days 2.5–3.5 g/kg. Always include 30–60 g carbs + 20–30 g protein pre-lift (60–120 min) and 30–60 g carbs + 25–35 g protein + sodium post-lift (0–2 h)
- Fats: 0.8–1.0 g/kg/day; fiber 25–35 g/day; prioritize low–moderate GI carbs, legumes, whole grains, fruit (berries, apples, citrus, kiwi)
- Add-ons if clinically appropriate: vitamin D if low, myo-inositol (± d-chiro) per MD, magnesium glycinate 200–400 mg, B12 if on metformin
- Meal-timing tactics: Plate method; veg/protein first; vinegar/lemon with starch; 10–15 min walks after meals; front-load breakfast if appetite allows

Recovery and biofeedback guardrails
- Sleep 7.5–9 h
- Steps 8–10k/day; 10–15 min post-meal walks
- Pull back if any: resting HR up >5 bpm for 3 days, sleep <6.5 h, persistent DOMS >72 h, mood/cravings worsen, cycle symptoms flare. First remove density/HIIT and reduce cardio; add 25–40 g carbs/day for 3–5 days.

Phase 1 — Foundation and Insulin Sensitivity (Weeks 1–4)
Goals: Technique, consistency, base volume, modest cardio. RPE mostly 6–7. Nutrition at maintenance Weeks 1–2; consider 10% deficit 3–4 days/week in Weeks 3–4 if recovery is solid.

Week 1 (2026-06-01 to 06-07)
- Mon Lower A
  - Back squat or goblet squat 3x8 @ RPE 6
  - Romanian deadlift 3x8
  - Split squat 3x8/side
  - Leg curl (machine or ball) 3x10
  - Standing calf raise 2x12
  - Side plank 2x30–40 s/side
- Tue Upper A
  - DB bench press 3x8
  - One-arm DB row 3x10/side
  - Seated DB shoulder press 3x8
  - Lat pulldown/assisted pull-up 3x10
  - Incline push-up 2x10–12
  - Pallof press 2x10/side
- Thu Full Body A
  - Trap bar or KB deadlift 3x6
  - Front-foot-elevated split squat 3x8/side
  - Push-up (incline as needed) 3x8–10
  - Cable row 3x10
  - Hip thrust 2x10
  - Farmer carry 2x30–40 m
- Sat Conditioning
  - 20–25 min Zone 2 (walk, bike), plus 8–10 min mobility
- Add-on cardio: 2 x 20–30 min brisk walks Wed and/or Sun (Zone 1–2)
- Nutrition: Maintenance; pre/post fueling as above

Week 2
- Progress load +2.5–5% or +1 rep if RPE ≤7
- Squat 4x8; DB press 4x8; RDL 3x8; maintain others
- Conditioning: 25–30 min Zone 2; plus 2 x 30 min Zone 2 on non-lifting days
- Total cardio ~90 min
- Nutrition: Maintenance; glycaemic-control plate method

Week 3
- Lower B: Keep sets; RDL 4x8; add band lateral walk 2x12/side
- Upper B: Add face pull 2x12; keep rows/pulls 4x10
- Full Body B: Trap bar deadlift 4x5; hip thrust 3x8; farmer carry 3x30–40 m
- Sat: 25–30 min Zone 2 + 4 x 10–15 s relaxed spin-ups
- Add: 2 x 30–35 min Zone 2 midweek
- Consider starting ≤10% deficit on 3–4 days if energy and sleep solid

Week 4 — Deload/Technique
- Reduce volume ~30%, RPE ≤6 on all lifts
- Conditioning: 20 min easy Zone 1–2; walks 2 x 20–25 min easy
- Nutrition: If deficit started, bring to maintenance for this deload week to support recovery

Phase 2 — Intensified Strength and Controlled Density (Weeks 5–8)
Goals: Heavier main lifts with top sets, crisp back-offs, modest density, careful cardio. 1 optional HIIT session in Week 5 or 7 (not both) if recovery is excellent. Keep deficit modest (≤10%) on 3–4 days/week; eat at maintenance on heaviest lower day.

Week 5
- Mon Lower Strength 1
  - Back squat: top set 4 @ RPE 8–8.5; then 3x4 @ -8–10%
  - RDL 4x5 @ RPE 7.5–8
  - Walking lunge 3x10/side @ RPE 7
  - Leg curl 3x8–10 @ RPE 8
  - Core: cable chop 3x10/side
  - Optional density: 6-min EMOM (8 goblet squats light / 10 band pull-throughs), leave 3 RIR
- Tue Upper Strength 1
  - Bench (BB/DB): top set 4 @ RPE 8–8.5; 3x4 @ -8–10%
  - Chest-supported row 4x6–8 @ RPE 8
  - Half-kneeling landmine press 3x6–8/side
  - Lat pulldown (neutral) 4x6–8 @ RPE 8
  - Superset: DB curl 2x10–12 + rope pressdown 2x10–12 (2–3 RIR)
  - Optional density: 5-min AMRAP of 6–10 push-ups + 12–15 band pull-aparts (2–3 RIR)
- Thu Full-Body Strength 1
  - Trap bar deadlift 6x3 @ RPE 7.5–8, speed focus, 2–3 min rest
  - Bulgarian split squat 3x8/side @ RPE 8
  - Push-up progression 3xAMRAP leaving 2 RIR
  - One-arm cable row 3x10/side
  - Hip thrust 3x6–8 @ RPE 8
  - Finisher: Farmer carry 3x40–50 m heavy
- Sat Conditioning (choose one)
  - HIIT Option 1 (bike/row): 8–10 min warm-up; 6–8 x 60 s @ RPE 8 with 90 s easy; 5–8 min cool-down; or
  - If not doing HIIT: 30 min steady Zone 2
- Add another Zone 2: Sun 35–40 min
- Total cardio aim: 100–120 min including HIIT
- Nutrition: High end of carbs on Mon/Thu; deficit days limited to non-peak days

Week 6
- Mon Lower Strength 2
  - Back squat: top set 3 @ RPE 8–8.5; then 3x3 @ -8–10%
  - RDL 4x5 @ RPE 8 (add 2.5–5 kg if Week 5 ≤8)
  - Single-leg RDL 2x8/side @ RPE 7
  - Leg curl 3x8–10 @ RPE 8
  - Lateral band walk 2x12/side + Copenhagen plank 2x20 s/side
- Tue Upper Strength 2
  - Bench: top set 3 @ RPE 8–8.5; 3x3 @ -8–10%
  - Chest-supported row 4x6–8 @ RPE 8
  - Seated DB shoulder press 3x6–8 @ RPE 8
  - Pull-up/pulldown 4x6–8 @ RPE 8
  - Rear delt raise 2x12
  - Optional density: 6-min EMOM alternating 6–8 TRX rows / 8–10 incline push-ups (2–3 RIR)
- Thu Full-Body Strength 2
  - Trap bar deadlift 5x3 @ RPE 8
  - Hip thrust 4x6 @ RPE 8
  - Front-foot-elevated split squat 3x8/side @ RPE 8
  - One-arm cable row 3x10/side
  - Sled push or bike: 6 x 8–10 s smooth accelerations, long easy recoveries
- Sat Conditioning
  - 25–30 min steady Zone 2 (lighter than Week 5)
- Add: 1 additional Zone 2 35–40 min on Sun
- Total cardio ~110–120 min
- Nutrition: Keep carbs high on Mon/Thu; deficit ≤10% on 3–4 days max

Week 7 — Peak Week of Phase
- Mon Lower Peak
  - Back squat 4x3 @ RPE 8; then 1 AMRAP set at same load, stop at 1–2 RIR (likely 3–5 reps)
  - RDL 4x4–5 @ RPE 8
  - Leg press 3x8–10 @ tempo 3-1-1, RPE 8
  - Hamstring curl 3x8–10 @ RPE 8
  - Hanging knee raise 3x8–10
- Tue Upper Peak
  - Bench 4x3 @ RPE 8; then 1 AMRAP set 1–2 RIR (3–5 reps)
  - Chest-supported row 4x5–6 @ RPE 8
  - Landmine or DB overhead press 3x5–6 @ RPE 8
  - Pull-up/pulldown 4x6–8 @ RPE 8
  - DB curl 2x10–12 + rope pressdown 2x10–12 (2–3 RIR)
  - Optional very short density: 4-min EMOM 6 push-ups / 10 band pull-aparts
- Thu Full-Body Peak
  - Trap bar deadlift 6x2–3 @ RPE 8, crisp
  - Hip thrust 4x5–6 @ RPE 8
  - Bulgarian split squat 3x6–8/side @ RPE 8
  - Push-up 3x8–12 with 2 RIR (add load if needed)
  - Farmer carry 3x50 m heavy
- Sat Conditioning
  - 20–25 min easy Zone 2 + 10–15 min mobility (keep stress low)
- Optional HIIT this week only if Week 5 HIIT was skipped and recovery is excellent: place on Wed or Sun, not Sat, and replace one Zone 2 bout (do not add on top)
- Nutrition: Maintenance or slight surplus (+100–150 kcal) on Mon; high-carb fueling pre/post

Week 8 — Deload
- Reduce volume ~40%, RPE ≤6; remove all density, sled/bike accelerations, and HIIT
- Mon: Squat 3x3 @ ~70% of Week 7; RDL 2x5 easy; accessories 1–2 sets each
- Tue: Bench 3x3 @ ~70%; rows/pulls 2x8 light; one arm press 2x8 light
- Thu: Trap bar deadlift 3x2 @ ~70%; hip thrust 2x5; split squat 2x6 light
- Sat: 20–25 min easy Zone 1–2
- Nutrition: Deload at maintenance; keep carbs around training to recover

Phase 3 — Consolidation + Metabolic Density + Submax Testing (Weeks 9–12)
Goals: Maintain/solidify strength, add brief density blocks, keep cardio modest, then test with safe submax top sets and e1RM estimates in Week 12. No true 1RM.

Week 9
- Mon Lower
  - Back squat 4x5 @ RPE 7–8
  - RDL 4x5–6 @ RPE 7–8
  - Leg press 3x10 @ tempo 3-1-1
  - Hamstring curl 3x8–10
  - Hanging knee raise 3x8–10
  - Density finisher: 6-min EMOM alt 8 goblet squats (light) / 8 KB swings (light), 3 RIR
- Tue Upper
  - Bench/DB press 4x5 @ RPE 7–8
  - Chest-supported row 4x6–8
  - Seated DB shoulder press 3x6–8
  - Lat pulldown 3x8
  - Cable fly 2x12; Face pull 2x12
  - Density: 6-min EMOM alt 8 push-ups / 10 band pull-aparts, 2–3 RIR
- Thu Full Body
  - Trap bar deadlift 4x3–4 @ RPE 7–8
  - Front-foot-elevated split squat 3x8/side
  - One-arm cable row 3x10/side
  - Hip thrust 3x6–8
  - Farmer carry 3x40–50 m
- Sat Conditioning
  - Choose one: keep programmed 10 x 60 s Z3-/60 s Z1- (submax tempo), or replace with HIIT Option 1 if desired (not both)
- Add: 1 additional Zone 2 35–40 min another day
- Nutrition: Modest deficit ok 3–4 days; keep carbs adequate on Mon/Thu

Week 10
- Mon Lower
  - Back squat 4x5 @ slight load increase (RPE 7–8)
  - RDL 4x5–6
  - Leg press 3x10 tempo
  - Hamstring curl 3x8–10
  - Glute med circuit: lateral band walk 2x12/side + Copenhagen plank 2x20 s/side
- Tue Upper
  - Bench 4x5
  - Row 4x6–8
  - Seated DB press 3x6–8
  - Lat pulldown 3x8
  - Cable fly 2x12; Face pull 2x12
- Thu Full Body
  - Trap bar deadlift 4x3–4 @ RPE 7–8
  - Split squat 3x8/side
  - One-arm cable row 3x10/side
  - Hip thrust 3x6–8
  - Farmer carry 3x40–50 m
- Sat Conditioning
  - 25–30 min Zone 2 (swap modality if legs sore)
- Add: Optional 2 x 8 min tempo (Z3-) with 3 min easy once this week, only if recovery is good (insert into a Zone 2 session)
- Nutrition: Keep deficit modest; high-carb fueling on lift days

Week 11 — Strength Priority (reduce density)
- Mon Lower
  - Back squat 5x3 @ RPE 8
  - RDL 4x4–5 @ RPE 8
  - Leg press 2x8 tempo (reduced)
  - Hamstring curl 2x8 (reduced)
- Tue Upper
  - Bench 5x3 @ RPE 8
  - Chest-supported row 4x5–6
  - Pull-up/pulldown 4x6–8
  - Overhead press 2x5–6 (reduced)
- Thu Full Body
  - Trap bar deadlift 5x2–3 @ RPE 8
  - Hip thrust 4x4–6
  - Bulgarian split squat 2x6–8/side (reduced)
- Density finishers cut to 4-min EMOM or removed if fatigue present
- Sat Conditioning: 20–25 min easy Zone 2 + long mobility
- Nutrition: Prefer maintenance on Mon/Thu, keep carbs high to set up testing

Week 12 — Submax Testing and Consolidation (no true 1RM)
- Testing approach: Work to safe top sets at RPE ~8, use e1RM (Epley = load x [1 + reps/30]); no grinders. Optional technical single @ ~RPE 8 after top set (85–90% e1RM), 1 attempt only.
- Mon Lower (Squat emphasis)
  - Back squat: build to top set of 5 @ RPE ~8; then 2x5 @ -10%
  - RDL 3x6 @ RPE 7
  - Leg press 2x10 easy
- Tue Upper (Bench emphasis)
  - Bench/DB press: top set of 5 @ RPE ~8; then 2x5 @ -10%
  - Row 3x6–8 heavy
  - Lat pulldown 2x8–10
- Thu Full Body (Deadlift emphasis)
  - Trap bar deadlift: top set of 3 @ RPE ~8; then 2x3 @ -10%
  - Bulgarian split squat 2x8/side moderate
  - Hip thrust 2x6 moderate
- Sat Conditioning: Optional 30–35 min Zone 2 or rest if fatigued

- Weeks 1–2: ~70–90 min/week Zone 1–2

Progression rules
- Add load when prescribed sets/reps complete at target RPE with clean form
- Lower body: +2.5–5 kg; upper: +1–2.5 kg; or add 1 rep to final set before loading
- Keep 1–3 RIR on accessories and all density/conditioning efforts
- If a session is missed, skip and resume the plan; avoid 3 consecutive training days

Safety and PCOS-specific notes
- Avoid fasted HIIT and very low-carb training days
- If bleeding starts with heavy symptoms: reduce lower-body loads 10–15% and drop 1 set for 1–3 days; keep movement for relief
- Watch under-fuelling signs: rising resting HR, sleep disruption, irritability, cycle irregularity, stalled strength. Respond by easing cardio/density and increasing carbs/calories slightly.
